decisions.reason: The BOM already has a message-199 MODIFY recording suitable LEDs compatible with the existing setup, so no additional or edited Event is required.
Selecting compatible LEDs does not change the established beige and green color requirements.
The LED selection does not alter matcha mixing, frothing, whisk geometry, or whisk positioning requirements.
LED selection around the bowls does not change the independently specified measurement-style bowl markings.
The client approves compatible LEDs but explicitly remains unclear about the proposed button substitution, so no decorative-control change is established.
The general desire for a visually appealing base does not change the established base logo, font, letter case, or leaf treatment.
The LED decision does not alter the machine placard wording, placement, or viewing orientations.
The source does not change the cursive K markings, their color, or their coverage on the dispense buttons.
Lighting component selection does not change bowl capacity, depth, geometry, or enclosure-size constraints.
The LED decision has no necessary effect on spout material, location, orientation, appearance, or pour direction.
Selecting compatible LEDs does not alter splash targets or acceptable splash-mitigation methods.
The LEDs are not identified as food-contact components, and their selection does not change the food-safe contact-material standard.
